summary: Marwynn Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing it received a Nasdaq notice on July 10, 2026 confirming it had regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company had previously been notified of non-compliance when its bid price fell below $1.00; compliance was restored after 10 consecutive trading sessions (June 25–July 9, 2026) with the stock at $1.00 or above. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No terms, deal structure, or board recommendation are provided. Event is purely a listing status update.
